error_unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again later.
contact_dsa_text: Point of contact under the Digital Services Act (DSA). Accepted languages: {languages}.
contact_privacy_text: For your rights over your personal data.
data_licence_text: The archive's structured data is published under this licence:
data_licence_scope: It covers neither the documentation files, each of which has its own licence, nor the artworks they depict.
licence_odbl_1_0: Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL) 1.0
tart_intro: TART is the collaborative platform this archive runs on, for documenting and preserving the history of urban art. Each local archive is independent and run by its own community.
tart_licence_text: The TART software is source-available and freely available for non-commercial use, under this licence:
tart_licence_scope: The software licence covers neither the TART name and logo, nor this archive's data, nor contributors' content, nor the artworks.
tart_credits_empty: This version of TART includes no third-party assets.
error_403_text: You do not have permission to view this page.
error_410_text: This content has been removed from the archive.
sign_in_intro: Enter your email address and we will send you a code to sign in. There is no password.
sign_in_registration_open: If you do not have an account yet, you will create one after entering the code.
sign_in_registration_invite: New accounts are by invitation only: use the address your invitation was sent to.
sign_in_registration_closed: This archive is not accepting new accounts at the moment.
sign_in_code_sent: We have sent an email to {email}. Enter the 6-digit code it contains: it is valid for 10 minutes.
sign_in_register_intro: There is no account for {email} yet: two more things and you are in.
sign_in_display_name_hint: Shown next to your contributions; it can be a pseudonym. From 1 to 40 characters; you can change it later.
sign_in_age_label: I declare that I am at least {age} years old
sign_in_error_email_invalid: Enter a valid email address, such as name@example.org.
sign_in_error_code_invalid: The code is wrong or has expired. Check it, or ask for a new code.
sign_in_error_rate_limited: Too many code requests for this address or network. You can ask again {when}.
sign_in_error_age_not_confirmed: To create an account you must declare that you are at least {age} years old.
sign_in_error_display_name_length: The display name must be from 1 to 40 characters long.
sign_in_error_display_name_control_chara: The display name contains characters that cannot be used.
sign_in_error_display_name_reserved: This display name is reserved: choose another one.
error_403_moderator_text: This area is for the archive's Moderators, and your account does not have that role. If you think it should, write to the archive's contacts.
sign_in_passkey_intro: If you have added a passkey to your account, you can sign in with it, without a code.
sign_in_passkey_hint: No passkey yet? Sign in with the code and add one on the Account page.
sign_in_error_passkey_invalid: Signing in with this passkey did not work. Try again, or sign in with the email code.
sign_in_error_passkey_cancelled: No passkey was used. Try again whenever you like, or sign in with the email code.
account_name_intro: It is shown next to your contributions, past ones included. It can be a pseudonym.
account_language_hint: The language of the emails the archive sends you.
account_error_language_unavailable: This language is not available in the archive.
account_email_hint: We send a code to the new address: the address changes only once you enter it. Your sessions and passkeys stay as they are.
account_email_code_sent: We have sent an email to {email}. Enter the 6-digit code it contains: it is valid for 10 minutes.
account_error_email_unchanged: This is already your email address.
account_sessions_intro: Ends every session of your account, on every device, this one included. Use it if you lost a device or think someone else has signed in.
account_passkeys_intro: With a passkey you sign in on this device with your fingerprint, face, or PIN, without waiting for the email code. The code always remains available.
account_passkeys_empty: You have not added any passkeys yet.
account_passkey_name_hint: To recognise it in the list, for example “Phone” or “Laptop”. 1 to 40 characters.
account_passkeys_unsupported: This browser cannot use passkeys. You can add one from another browser or device.
account_passkey_added: Passkey “{name}” added: next time you can sign in with it.
account_error_passkey_invalid: The passkey could not be added. Try again.
account_error_passkey_cancelled: The passkey was not created. If this device already has one for this archive, you will find it in the list.
account_error_passkey_name_length: The passkey name must be 1 to 40 characters long.
account_error_passkey_name_control_chara: The passkey name contains characters that cannot be used.
account_error_passkey_not_found: This passkey is no longer there: you may have removed it already.
map_canvas: Interactive map: the arrow keys move it, plus and minus zoom
map_attribution_toggle: Show or hide the map credits
map_legend_present: Solid square: at least one artwork is present
map_legend_unknown: Dotted square with a question mark: condition unknown
map_legend_disappeared: Dashed square: the artworks have disappeared
map_legend_stack: Second outline: more than one artwork on the same surface
map_legend_cluster: Circle: a group of nearby places, with the number of artworks
map_cluster_name: Cluster of {artworks} in {locations}; activate to zoom in
archive_pdf_preview_alt: First page of a PDF document
archive_licence_file_only: Licence: {licence}, which covers the file only, not the artwork
archive_minimap_note: The map of this place is not shown here; its position is described in words.
archive_withdrawn_banner: Withdrawn on {date}. The public sees that this content was removed.
archive_rights_third_party: third-party work published under this licence
archive_stratigraphy_heading: Artworks on this surface, most recent first
archive_revisions_intro: Every approved change to this record, most recent first.
archive_value_geometry: a new position on the map
draw_click_hint: Click the map to add a vertex. Click a vertex to select it, then click elsewhere to move it. Click a small circle between two vertices to insert a vertex there.
draw_crosshair_hint: The crosshair marks the centre of the map. Move the map with the arrow keys or the map controls, then use the buttons below to act at the crosshair.
draw_crosshair_mark: Crosshair at the centre of the map
draw_insert_here: Insert vertex here, after the selected one
draw_problem_outside_boundary: That position is outside the area this archive covers.
draw_problem_too_few_line: A line needs at least 2 vertices.
draw_problem_too_few_polygon: An area needs at least 3 vertices.
draw_problem_self_intersecting: The outline crosses itself. Move or delete a vertex so that it does not.
draw_problem_nothing_to_do: Nothing to do: select a vertex first.
location_entry_coordinates_hint: Decimal degrees (41.8986, 12.4769), degrees-minutes-seconds, a geo: link, or a link from OpenStreetMap or Google Maps.
location_entry_error_empty: Enter coordinates or paste a map link.
location_entry_error_unrecognised: These coordinates were not recognised. Try decimal degrees, degrees-minutes-seconds, a geo: link, or a link from OpenStreetMap or Google Maps.
location_entry_error_short_link: A shortened link does not contain the coordinates. Open it, then paste the address from the browser or the coordinates themselves.
location_entry_error_out_of_range: Latitude must be between -90 and 90 and longitude between -180 and 180.
location_entry_error_outside_boundary: These coordinates are outside the area this archive covers.
location_entry_position_reminder: The Location is where the artwork is, not where you are. Use your position only when you are standing at the artwork. Your position is not stored.
location_entry_position_denied: Access to your position was refused. Enter the coordinates instead.
location_entry_position_unavailable: Your position could not be found. Enter the coordinates instead.
location_entry_radius_hint: For a fragile piece, or one on private property, enter an approximate position with a wide radius: the archive keeps no hidden precise position.
location_entry_radius_error: Enter a whole number of metres greater than 0, or leave it empty.
location_entry_no_map: Drawing a line or an area needs the map, which is not available here. Enter a point that represents it and describe its extent in the note to the Moderators. The geometry can be refined later with a separate Submission on that Location.
location_entry_search_label: Search by Site, Area, or text
location_entry_duplicates: Similar Locations already in the archive
